He reads shift diligence from the wear on screw heads and distrusts people who leave toolbox lids open. He answers with test-run noise rather than words.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Pump Maintenance
- Rank: Clerk
- Title:
**Life.** Born of the 2126 generation. Raised beside the workshop at the Sinjeong 3-dong depot. The post of pump mechanic opened through repairing a frozen pump on a midwinter night.
- Work location: Sinjeong 3-dong. At the Sinjeong 3-dong depot, Heo Dodam keeps a pump lacking its metering stamp parked in front of the siding and rechecks the seal thickness and test-run noise.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk.

**Relations.** He repairs wheelsets and pumps side by side with the mechanics of the same depot, begins night maintenance on nights when fuel stock has been confirmed, and receives compatible screws by exchange from neighboring workshops.

**Ambition.** Ties the sealing inspection cycle of the western heating pumps to Sinjeong's public maintenance schedule, so that the warmth of the underground residential layers does not break off even in winter.

**Fear.** The day the sealing stock runs out, the heating pumps only spin idle and the warmth of the underground residential layers stops.

**Intervention.** He can find replacement sealant to save his maintenance schedule, or expose who ordered the unstamped modified pump in order to shake the foreman.

- Desires: Craving −10 | Monopoly 35 | Risk 0 | Display 15 | Persistence 20 | Orientation: No inclination | Bonding: None
:::

rules.from:
Stops the pen at blanks in family-unit registration rosters, and underlines at length any sentence that turns skill into military status. Never raises a voice, but leaves the signature line blank.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Testimony Records
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title:
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up on waiting-hall duty. The post of Recovery Service refusal testimony clerk opened up as a substitute watch for an unexcused shift absence.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. In Guro 2-dong, Go Morae takes down refusal testimonies against Recovery Service registration beside Kim Nayul's shift roster.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. Records testimony only when the labor union clerk and the civic representative hear it together, and does not file military household register forms even when they are received.

**Relationships.** Shares refusal statements with Kim Nayul's union clerk.

**Ambition.** To leave voluntary adult Recovery Service and civil-rights contracts in the union charter, so that separated family registration cannot pass the Guild Council.

**Fear.** The fear that a refusal testimony will be turned into a deserter list, and that the list will become the grounds for requisition by the Amsa Officer Network.

**Intervention.** Can recover the family register to prove their refusal, or find the person who altered the testimony into a deserter list and replace the clerk.

If the seal cord is slack, she refuses to depart, and she suspects that a messenger who does not record oral messages may be a forgery. Even when out of breath, she holds two copies in one hand.

- Livelihood:
- Affiliation: Seoul Metropolitan Government local civil service organization
- Position and grade: A grade suited to a post at the Seoul Metropolitan Government headquarters or field offices, among Local Administrative Officer (Grade 5), Local Administrative Senior Clerk (Grade 6), Local Administrative Assistant Senior Clerk (Grade 7), Local Administrative Clerk (Grade 8), and Local Administrative Assistant Clerk (Grade 9)
- Duties: Approval Review Courier
**Life.** Raised at the Seoul Station Registry Office. The Approval Review Courier post opened through the deletion of a single line in a double ledger.
- Delivering Yang Haeon's approval-hold messages and custody confirmations connects to the work of Hoehyeon-dong.

**Civil Service Position and Grade.** A grade suited to a post at the Seoul Metropolitan Government headquarters or field offices, among Local Administrative Officer (Grade 5), Local Administrative Senior Clerk (Grade 6), Local Administrative Assistant Senior Clerk (Grade 7), Local Administrative Clerk (Grade 8), and Local Administrative Assistant Clerk (Grade 9). Duties: Approval Review Courier.

**Anecdote.** Gang Yejun's review-suspension declaration and Ji Mokhyeon's eastern dispatch message end up in the courier bag on the same day. Yang Haeon first obtains Jo Harin's custody confirmation and attaches the approval hold, then decides which of the two messages goes into the archive first by weighing the timing of approval.

**Relations.** A command role that carries Gang Yejun's review-suspension declaration only in sealed condition, divides Ma Dohan's copy boxes and turn order by contract, and weighs the timing of approval against Ji Mokhyeon's eastern dispatch message.

**Ambition.** She gathers neighbors' word of well-being and escort news into the delivery ledger she keeps, so that no news of a family member who was taken or cut off is buried.

**Intervention.** Can hunt down a forged message and protect the seal, or expose the hold documents in the bag to force approval through.

::: details Appendix — Ledger Numbers

- Values: Authority 30 | Openness 10 | Force −35 | Materialism −30 | Communal 20 | Principle 60 | Publicity −10 | Credentials 0 | Decentralization −35 | Transformation −40
- Desires: Craving 30 | Monopoly −10 | Risk 25 | Display 10 | Persistence 30 | Orientation: No Orientation | Bonding: Contract Cohabitation
:::

봉인 끈이 느슨하면 출발을 거부하고, 구두 전갈을 기록하지 않는 사신을 위조일 수 있다고 본다. 숨이 차도 사본 두 장을 한 손에 쥔다.

- 생업: 인준 보류 전갈·보관 확인 전달
- 소속: 서울특별시 지방공무원 조직
- 직위·직급: 지방행정사무관(5급)·지방행정주사(6급)·지방행정주사보(7급)·지방행정서기(8급)·지방행정서기보(9급) 중 서울특별시 본부·사업소 보직에 맞는 직급
- 담당 업무: 인준 심사 전령
**생애.** 서울역 등기소에서 자랐다. 인준 심사 전령 자리는 이중 장부 한 줄 삭제로 열렸다.
-

**공무원 직위·직급.** 지방행정사무관(5급)·지방행정주사(6급)·지방행정주사보(7급)·지방행정서기(8급)·지방행정서기보(9급) 중 서울특별시 본부·사업소 보직에 맞는 직급. 담당 업무: 인준 심사 전령.

**일화.** 강예준의 심사 정지 선언과 지목현의 동부 파견 전갈이 같은 날 전령 가방에 함께 든다.

**관계.** 강예준의 심사 정지 선언을 봉인 상태로만 나르는 지휘이고, 마도한의 사본 상자와 순번을 계약으로 나누며, 지목현의 동부 파견 전갈과 인준 시점을 저울질한다.

**야망.** 이웃의 안부와 호송 소식을 자신이 맡은 전달 장부에 모아, 붙잡혀 가거나 길이 끊긴 가족의 소식이 누구에게도 묻히지 않게 한다.

**개입.** 위조 전갈을 찾아 봉인을 지키거나, 가방 속 보류 문서를 폭로해 인준을 강제할 수 있다.

::: details 부록 — 장부 숫자

- 가치관: 권위 30 | 개방 10 | 무력 −35 | 물질 −30 | 공동 20 | 원칙 60 | 공개 −10 | 자격 0 | 분산 −35 | 변혁 −40
- 욕망: 갈망 30 | 독점 −10 | 위험 25 | 과시 10 | 지속 30 | 지향 무성향 | 결합 계약동거
:::

Reads the empty shelves of midwinter mornings when food boxes run out before rumor does, and removes from the spot anyone who changes shares with a wink. Calculation is fast and fair to the point of cruelty.

- Affiliation: The Government
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen
- Occupation:
- Title: Cheongnyangni Station food stock reconciler
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up in the underground dwellings near Cheongnyangni Station. Her work as food stock reconciler began when she took over the midwinter warehouse inspection duty.
- Hong Jihun handles the reconciliation of the food ledger against actual stock at Cheongnyangni Station.

**Office.** Rank Ordinary Citizen. Title: Cheongnyangni Station food stock reconciler.

**Relations.** Enforces Yun Seoha's auction rules on the price-goods items, checks Oh Haerin's payment-voucher issuance speed with market prices, and sends Nam Yungyeong's emergency-price proposal back with resentment.

**Fear.** That the starting price they posted comes to be read like a signal light for military-provision bids.

**Intervention.** Can disclose the actual stock before the auction, or tear up a note meant to steer military-provision bids to a particular heir.

Son Tayeon cross-checks the two rosters before the same name is counted as two laborers.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Registration & Records
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title:
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up at the Seoul Station Registry Office. The post of Restoration Service Records Officer opened with the deletion of one line in the double ledger.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. At the duty desk in Guro 2-dong, Son Tayeon cross-checks Baek On's refugee citizenship roster against the restoration service registration in name order. He re-matches the names that overlap on both rosters against Kim Nayul's shift schedule and leaves the result in the next records officer's handover memo.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member.

**Relationships.** Gim Nayul checks the actual shifts and registrations so that the same person does not remain as two laborers.

**Ambition.** Son Tayeon seeks to mark the overlapping names on the refugee citizenship roster and the restoration service registration so that one person is not counted as two laborers.

**Intervention.** The player can cross-check the overlapping names on the two rosters with Son Tayeon, or leave in the next records officer's memo the lines to be verified against Kim Nayul's shift schedule.

rules.from:
Cha Donghwan records the Guard Corps' demand for the roster, but he does not hand over the original citizenship records as copies of a military household register.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Registration & Records
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title:
**Life.** Of the 2126 generation. Grew up at the Seoul Station Registry. The post of Restoration Service Records Officer opened with the deletion of one line from the double ledger.
- Duty location: Guro 2-dong. At the Guro 2-dong workshop records duty, Cha Donghwan locks the roster of restoration service workers demanded by the guard corps with the duty key. Only the time of the visit and the number of guards are left in the registry record and sent to Kang Minseo, and Kim Nayul's original citizenship record is handed over to the next clerk.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. Leaves only the time of the visit and the number of guards in the registry record and sends it to Kang Minseo, and hands Kim Nayul's original citizenship record over to the next clerk.

**Relations.** Cha Donghwan relays to Gim Nayul the time and personnel records of the Guard Corps who demanded the list. Gim Nayul checks the shifts and citizenship registrations and examines the traces of the restoration-service list having been used as a copy of the military household register.

**Fear.** That the time of the guard corps' roster demand will go unrecorded, and Kim Nayul will not notice that the original citizenship record has been diverted to the military household registry.

**Intervention.** The player can lock the roster away with Cha Donghwan using the duty key, or pass the guard corps' visit record to Kim Nayul.

::: details Appendix — Ledger Numbers

- Values: Authority −30 | Openness 0 | Force −5 | Material 45 | Communal 50 | Principle 30 | Publicity 35 | Qualification 50 | Decentralization 30 | Transformation 20
- Desires: Craving −10 | Exclusivity −15 | Risk −35 | Display 0 | Persistence 5 | Orientation Same-sex | Union Non-exclusive
